messages.subject: Re: 3 Arm Bandit
parts:
Hello Martin,


Thanks for your interest in the package!


This should indeed be a simple change. Actually, it would make sense for us to incorporate a model that can handle N-armed bandit tasks in the future so that more people could make use of the default models. 


Is there a particular bandit model that you are interested in applying? 


Best,

Nate

messages.subject: Re: 3 Arm Bandit
parts:
Hi Martin,


I have attached a modified R script (modified version of  bandit4arm_4par.R) here that will accommodate the stan script that I attached before. You will have to source this R file to use the model, and then you will need to specify the path to the stan file with the stan_path argument I added. 


In the future, we hope to make a way to actually add models to the downloaded package, but for not this will have to do. 


Anyway, this should work! Let me know if you have any questions.


Best,

Nate
